【原视频简介】
Mountain Goat’s Cliffside Feeding Turns Into a Puma Chase | Wildlife Documentary

High above a deep alpine valley, a mountain goat climbs a near-vertical cliff in search of food. Sparse grass and small plants offer little nourishment, so the goat moves toward a long tree branch growing far out from the rock face. Balanced above the abyss, it begins feeding on fresh leaves — until a puma appears on the cliff behind it.

The predator watches and waits, unable to safely reach the goat while it remains far out on the branch. But when the mountain goat finally returns toward the rock wall, the situation changes instantly. A short but intense chase begins across narrow ledges high above the canyon. With the puma closing in, the goat reaches an enormous gap between two cliffs and must attempt one final risky escape across a long suspended rope.

Chapters
00:00 - Mountain Goat Climbs the Cliffside Branch
03:00 - Puma Appears and the Chase Begins
05:00 - Mountain Goat Crosses the Rope

This story shows how balance, terrain awareness, and careful movement can become powerful survival advantages in the mountains. Sometimes survival is not about being stronger or faster, but about using the environment better than the predator.

This video combines real wildlife footage with AI technology to recreate the situation in the safest possible way.
